text.tspan: FRAME — The same deletion, repeated as a wall: a retrospective grid
explicitly dated EXPORT WINDOW — 4 JUNE–14 JULY 2026, thousands

SCREEN / SYSTEM TEXT — “4 JUNE–14 JULY: 5,217 SUCCESSFUL
ADMINISTRATOR DELETIONS. 5,144 DISTINCT PAGES. ONE LABEL.”
CAPTION — “THE LOG RECORDS REMOVALS. IT DOES NOT RECORD
WHAT THE MAINTAINER KNEW. A SUCCESSFUL DELETION
ESTABLISHES THAT AN ACTION WAS COMPLETED ON A PAGE. IT
DOES NOT ESTABLISH THE MAINTAINER’S MOTIVE, THE CONTENT
